items.difficulty_reason: Graded adjunction for extension by zero with a degree shift: lifts the Modules-on-Sites adjunction between j_! and j^* to the category of graded modules, tracking degrees so that Hom(j_! M, N) matches Hom(M, j^* N) in each degree after the shift, computes the tensor description through the j-shriek-and-tensor lemma, and states the diagram-commutativity verification that is omitted as the matching of two obstruction elements. Retained author proof at lines 1099-1157.
